company.name: RudderStack
company.description: RudderStack is the Agentic Customer Data Platform. It gives data teams a warehouse native foundation for reliable pipelines, governance, and identity resolution, and gives marketers self serve access to that same data through agentic, natural language workflows. The result: data teams ship faster, business teams get trustworthy customer context on demand, and AI agents can act on governed data safely at scale.
